inventory.anchor: new static StealthUscitaUdpDirettaVietata (before NrSocket::sendto); hooks in NrSocket::sendto and NrUdpSocketIpc::sendto
inventory.notes: About 36 lines of address-range decision logic sit inside the Mozilla file, plus two 3-4 line hooks. The function can move to nr_stealth_bridge.cpp behind one call. Pref zoom.stealth.webrtc.no_direct_udp defined at StaticPrefList.yaml:21539. IPv4 0.0.0.0 passes (if (a == 0) return false), but IPv6 unspecified '::' is refused: all-zero bytes leave loopback=true, b[15]!=1, so the function returns true (CONFIRMED from the diff logic); real-world impact unverified. NrUdpSocketIpc::sendto returns R_REJECTED with no log line, unlike the NrSocket path. Merge note: upstream's comment '// This should be called on the STS thread.' now sits above the new block comment/function instead of above NrSocket::sendto.

verifier.why: Verified IPv6 :: logic from the diff; added the displaced upstream comment as a merge note.

inventory.notes: With SOCKS5 and network.proxy.socks_remote_udp set, pushes the SOCKS UDP layer (netwerk/socket/nsSOCKSUDPIOLayer.h:50, implemented at nsSOCKSUDPIOLayer.cpp:351) onto the new fd so QUIC/HTTP3 traffic goes through the proxy. network.proxy.socks_remote_udp is not defined in modules/libpref/init (read by string with default false). RISK CONFIRMED (from diff): if the layer attach fails the code logs 'falling back to direct UDP' and continues with direct UDP, and the block runs for every nsUDPSocket::InitWithAddress call with no check of the destination or purpose; whether callers avoid that path is unverified. The two Stealthfox comment blocks repeat each other. The block (about 26 logic lines) can move behind one call.

verifier.why: Added confirmed facts: pref not predefined, hook applies to every UDP socket; fallback behaviour confirmed from the diff.
